name: v1.3.0
body:
OctoWoW port of [Armor DR Compare](https://www.curseforge.com/wow/addons/armor-dr-compare) by alikara.

## What's included

- Displays armor DR% delta in item comparison tooltips on OctoWoW (vanilla 1.12.1 / interface 11200)
- Reads absolute armor values from both tooltips and computes the delta itself (vanilla shows `145 Armor`, not `+25 Armor`)
- Two display modes: `+-X Armor (+Y% DR)` or DR% only — toggle with `/adrc mode`
- Positive delta shown in green, negative in red
- DR info added as a **new line** in the tooltip; the original armor line is untouched
- Druid form armor multipliers (Bear / Dire Bear / Moonkin / Thick Hide) accounted for
- SavedVariables persist the display mode across sessions
- Compatible with ShaguTweaks equip-compare

## Commands

| Command | Action |
|---------|--------|
| `/adrc` | Current armor and DR% |
| `/adrc mode` | Toggle between full and DR-only display |
| `/adrc status` | Addon info and hook status |
| `/adrc dump` | Print all tooltip lines (debug) |

## Install

Extract into `Interface\AddOns\ArmorDRCompare-Octo\` and reload.
